use default
use Raster.IMAGE

use POINT = (x: double, y: double)

let steps = 200

cubic(a: POINT, b: POINT, c: POINT, d: POINT) -> List[POINT] =>
    (0..steps + 1)
        |> map(step =>
            (let t = cast double(step) / cast double(steps)
             let u = 1.0D - t

             (x = u * u * u * a.x + 3.0D * u * u * t * b.x +
                  3.0D * u * t * t * c.x + t * t * t * d.x,
              y = u * u * u * a.y + 3.0D * u * u * t * b.y +
                  3.0D * u * t * t * c.y + t * t * t * d.y)))
        |> collect_list()

let start = (x = 20.0D, y = 200.0D)
let first = (x = 60.0D, y = 20.0D)
let second = (x = 240.0D, y = 220.0D)
let finish = (x = 280.0D, y = 40.0D)

let image = IMAGE(300, 240)

image.colour(190ub, 190ub, 190ub)
image.stroke(1.0D)
image.line([start, first, second, finish])

image.colour(0ub, 0ub, 160ub)
image.stroke(2.0D)
image.line(cubic(start, first, second, finish))

image.write("cubic.png")

image.show("cubic.png")
